set.pl: A block of farms held by the Ogle family 2-5 km north of Medora (Squaw Twp secs. 4-17 and White Oak Twp secs. 28-33, 1920s Warren County farm atlas); his own forty not yet identified
set.t: A 1920s plat shows a block of farms held by the same family 2-5 km north of Medora; his own forty is not yet identified. A 1900s Warren County plat would pin his farm. One paper so far, so C. Access: private: permission.
